ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: The activation requests were not sent by the process that claimed them. Every attempt went through the official CLI (mmx-cli 1.0.27), whose request-auth resolver never reads the MINIMAX_API_KEY environment variable that ContentOps used to bind the authorised key; all three attempts authenticated with the Subscription Key stored in ~/.mmx/config.json, including the two labelled PAYG. The CLI also chose its request host from that same config (~/.mmx/config.json region=cn -> https://api.minimax.cn) while the balance evidence was read from CONTENTOPS_MINIMAX_BASE_URL (https://api.minimaxi.com), so the billing evidence and the billed request addressed two different configuration sources.
